# Roboto Flex

[日本語](README.ja.md)

The variable font Roboto Flex, from `ofl/robotoflex/` of [google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts) at commit `06bfe0d62a98375cb09c942fa18e68bd32cff057`, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`). `METADATA.pb` and `upstream_info.md` are the files of the same directory.

| File | Upstream name | Size |
|---|---|---|
| `RobotoFlex.ttf` | `RobotoFlex[GRAD,XOPQ,XTRA,YOPQ,YTAS,YTDE,YTFI,YTLC,YTUC,opsz,slnt,wdth,wght].ttf` | 1 787 292 bytes |

The font is unchanged and programs embed it unchanged; only the name is shortened, since brackets and commas are awkward in CMake paths. lamina-ui sets `wght` and `opsz` (8 to 144); the other axes keep their defaults unless a program pins them ([docs/resources.md](../../docs/resources.md)).
